title: Accessibility | Apple Developer Documentation - [Mobility](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/accessibility\#Mobility)
claim: Support simple gestures for common interactions.** For many people, with or without disabilities, complex gestures can be challenging. For interactions people do frequently in your app or game, use the simplest gesture possible — avoid custom multifinger and multihand gestures — so repetitive actions are both comfortable and easy to remember.
